morph.about: German inflection and derivation stripped before a lookup (longest suffix first, then the umlaut back to its vowel: 'taelern' -> tal); compounds whose head says nothing ('hoehlensystem' -> hoehle, 'heidelandschaft' -> heide); only for words no exact form knows
morph.about_no_cross: English forms a German wish's word is never guessed into by a word form, an umlaut back-off or a fuzzy match ('Heide' is no hide, 'shoene' no stone, 'hoelen' no hole)

everyday.about: how often each everyday word occurs in the tuned corpus - a typo one letter off an everyday word ('vil', 'wil', 'mti') is corrected to the most frequent one (SymSpell's ranking), never to a rarer one
